teaser: Three new messages are waiting, and before opening any of them you already know which friend needs cheering and which one is fine — that fast sense belongs to the ENFJ in you, and the life path 3 is the one supplying the right words once you open them. Crossed, the charm keeps working even on a night there was none left to give, and the line that makes a whole room laugh can arrive before you've decided to say it. What is particular here is how little daylight sits between feeling something and performing it — the performance often is the feeling, not a mask laid over it.
